Loop Live:
one day, one room
What it is and who it is for, the day itself, the budget and the break-even line, and what we need approved today.
the venue holds the date until Friday
Our customers have never been in one room. Four hundred finance leaders, one day, and the 2027 plan announced from the stage.
Why now: the moment this event captures
they keep asking when we will do this
Four hundred seats, three kinds of guest
Finance leaders at the accounts that renew in 2027. They hear the plan first, from the stage.
Late-stage deals, invited as a guest of their rep and seated with a customer in their industry.
Four sponsors, the analysts who cover us, and the two writers who asked to come.
every prospect sits next to a customer

Put four hundred of us in one room
and I will bring my CFO, my board pack
and every question I have been saving.
Group Finance Director, Harbor and Vale. Customer advisory board
A glass hall on the river, twenty minutes from the airport, with a terrace that faces west. Held for us until Friday.
Shuttles every fifteen minutes, both ways
A hall that seats four hundred
Cabaret tables, one stage, one screen
Forty seats each, on the floor above
Drinks from five, the band at six, sunset at half past eight
the terrace is why we picked it
The 2027 plan, two customer stories on stage, and one launch nobody expects.
Three tracks, forty people each, hands on with their own data.
The product team on stage, the questions from the floor, nothing off the table.
Drinks on the terrace, the band at six, and the photo everyone posts.
the band is on hold too, until Friday
Costs, sponsorships, and the break-even line
Fixed once the venue signs; every other line has a cap.
Two confirmed in principle, two in conversation.
Customers pay; prospects come as guests of their rep.
Twelve enterprise deals sourced at the event pays for it.
nine deals came out of one dinner
Programme, stage, and the run of show.
Partners on the floor and every prospect's rep in the room.
Registration, the product wall, workshops and the terrace.
The plan, the launch, and the two customers on stage.
all four have run one of these before
Approve the venue deposit and the $380K budget today; the venue holds the date until Friday.
Full budget and venue proposal attached
